cohort: The study included 150 term pregnant women diagnosed with oligohydramnios (AFI <= 5 cm).
finding: Oligohydramnios at term is significantly associated with increased operative delivery and neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: 65.3% of participants with oligohydramnios underwent cesarean section due to fetal distress and meconium-stained liquor.
birth_weight: Neonates born from term pregnancies, with 28% categorized as low birth weight (<2.5 kg).
